source_excerpts.text:
The campaign reconstructed eventual amplifier entropy-power inequalities after actual added heat for broad sources with exponential photon tails, including internal covariance/coherence. A later reviewed bridge reaches a family with **finite energy and no finite photon moment above one**. Its thermal-scale density is

\[
f_R(r)=C r^{-2}(\ln r)^{-p}
\left[1+\frac{d}{\ln r}+o\!\left(\frac1{\ln r}\right)\right],\quad p>1.
\]

The proof derives the actual quantum entropy defect through its second term, rather than replacing the quantum output by a classical surrogate. The leading defects cancel between the two amplifier inputs; the next term gives a strictly positive eventual gap for fixed sources and fixed gain. Finite energy alone does not justify every tail estimate: the precise supplied tail expansion is essential, and the heat threshold depends on the source.

A mandatory correction is bound to the proof: fixed shifts preserve the required two-term expansion, but the total relative density change need not have order 1/r under an oscillatory remainder. The review checked that the weaker valid statement suffices. The closing cold W39 review also passed a wider smooth-integrable-log-envelope theorem, including near-critical densities of the form 1/[r squared ln r (ln ln r)^q], q>1, and two input envelopes whose ratio need not converge. It reconstructs the actual quantum Poisson/Gamma squeeze and every growing-shift/cancellation term. Correlated shared-temperature multimode extensions remain separately pending.

Why this matters: it removes unnecessary higher-moment assumptions for a genuine heavy-tail class and gives tools for actual quantum entropy, not just numerical evidence. It does not prove the general unheated finite-energy amplifier conjecture, a uniform practical heating threshold, or an energy-efficient physical protocol.

Evidence: finite-energy proof SHA2167da8029a740a937b5ae477a1bf984fd34d4f9b6c02ce001ee02c8bc191e6e; [fresh complete review](/Users/harjas/Documents/Codex/2026-10-23/astra-civilisation-changing-discovery-with-35-2/outputs/checkpoints/v10/w49__log_tail_entropy_audit__FULL_FRESH_LOG_TAIL_AUDIT_V1.md); mandatory correction in the same checkpoint; [cold full smooth-envelope review](/Users/harjas/Documents/Codex/2026-10-23/astra-civilisation-changing-discovery-with-35-2/outputs/final_evidence/W39_SMOOTH_ENVELOPE__REPORT.md).

# A second-order entropy bridge with no photon moment above one

23 October 2026. W38. NEW independent candidate; full fresh criticism
pending. No earlier proof or receipt is changed. General UNHEATED
finite-energy independent-input amplifier EPnI remains NOT_ACHIEVED.

## 1. Exact proposed class, asymptotic, and two-port consequence

Let R>=0 have arbitrary probability law on a bounded interval and an
eventually continuous density with the precise tail

    f_R(r)=C r^-2 (ln r)^(-p)
                     [1+d/(ln r)+o(1/ln r)],
    C>0, p>1, d real.                                  L1

Its mean a is finite, but ER^(1+epsilon)=infinity for EVERY epsilon>0.
Let rho_R=E tau_R be the actual unflagged one-mode thermal mixture. It
therefore has finite mean photon number and no finite photon moment above
one. Write l=ln T and gamma_E for Euler's constant. The proposed actual
normal quantum relative-entropy expansion is

    D(H_T rho_R||tau_(T+a))
      =C/T *{l^(1-p)/(p-1)
                -l^-p[ln l+gamma_E-d/p]}
          +o(T^-1 l^-p).                              L2

The SECOND term matters. For two independent sources of this class with
the SAME p>1, arbitrary C_A,C_B>0 and d_A,d_B, fixed G>1, lambda=G-1,
s=2G-1, theta=G/s and phi=lambda/s, the proposed actual entropy-form EPnI
gap is

    [-theta C_A ln theta-phi C_B ln phi]
                         /[T(ln T)^p]
        +o(T^-1(ln T)^-p)>0 eventually.                L3

The leading l^(1-p)/T terms cancel. No assumption of any finite higher
photon moment, relative L2 norm or exponential tail is hidden in L2/L3.
The precise supplied tail law is stronger than arbitrary finite energy.
Actual equal input heat T remains part of the result, with fixed sources
and gain before T grows.

## 2. Exact radial representation and notation

As in the separate thermal-mixture notes, the coherent amplitude at heat
t has squared-radius density
